title: Count Files in Directory
description: Count regular files in a directory recursively.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

DIRECTORY="${1:-.}"

if [[ ! -d "$DIRECTORY" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Directory does not exist: $DIRECTORY" >&2
    exit 1
fi

COUNT=$(find "$DIRECTORY" -type f | wc -l)

echo "Regular files under $DIRECTORY: $COUNT"
